additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Charging stations from the 314164726 series have a serial number
without a slash. The station with the number: Y2/S2 314164726/003 has a slash in the serial number, but not on the nameplate.
The problem is that the station sends logs to SCB, but it does not appear to be active. Should the serial number be changed in the
SCB configuration? Please help.
